resources.string: Checked on this phone, offline. No check is perfect: if in doubt, do not open it.
This kind of link can run code or open internal files. It has been blocked.
The link hides its real destination behind an @. What comes before it is decoration.
It points to a bare IP address instead of a website name.
The address uses look-alike letters (punycode) that can imitate a known site.
The address contains non-Latin letters that can imitate a known site.
It mentions a known brand, bank or agency, but the site does not belong to it.
It downloads an app or program. Only install apps from official stores.
It contains invisible characters that can disguise what the text says.
The site name is encoded to hide what it really is.
The connection is not encrypted (http). Do not type passwords or card numbers.
It is a shortened or redirect link: the final destination is unknown.
The domain ending is often used by scams.
It uses an unusual port, which legitimate sites rarely do.
The site name uses words typical of scams (login, verify, refund, fine...).
It redirects to another address hidden inside the link.
The address has many parts, a trick to bury the real domain.
It opens another app on your phone instead of a website.
It is a crypto payment request. Payments cannot be undone: check the address.
It contains a two-factor authentication secret. Only add it if you created it.
It contains a service code (* or #) that could change phone settings, such as diverting your calls. Dialling is disabled.
It is a premium-rate number: calls or messages can be expensive.
It sends an SMS to a short number, which can subscribe you to paid services.
The message text is already written. Read it before sending.
Open Wi-Fi network without password: others can see your traffic.
The network uses WEP, an obsolete and easily broken security.
QR-Flow found warning signs in this code. Only continue if you trust where it came from.
No app can open this link
Scans are not saved to history, copies are hidden and erased after a minute, and screenshots are blocked.
History is turned off. You can enable it in Privacy.
History is encrypted on this phone and is never uploaded. QR-Flow has no internet permission.
